description: The Pro commissioning sheet for a design: the tests after installation of its voltage (the rows of design_cable after_installation, IEC 60502-2 clause 20, IEC 60840, IEC 62067, HD 620, BS, IEEE 400.2), each with its voltage, duration and source, as a PDF with fields to record the results. A separate paid call: its own price, never inside the design price. input: {tests?: [row ids of after_installation] (default every row), variant?: HD620-10A | HD620-10C | HD620-10J | HD620-10M | HD620-10R | BS6622 | BS7846 | BS5467 | HD603-3F | HD603-G, length?: route length (m)}. $0.50 per calculation in USDC with x402; no free allowance; a list of up to 50 items at $0.50 per item, one payment.

design.description: Instead of a sentence: the design field of a design_cable answer.

input.description: input: {tests?: [row ids of after_installation] (default every row), variant?: HD620-10A | HD620-10C | HD620-10J | HD620-10M | HD620-10R | BS6622 | BS7846 | BS5467 | HD603-3F | HD603-G, length?: route length (m)}

items.description: Instead of one: a project's list, 1 to 50 items, each {sentence | spec | design, input}; always in full, paid per item.

lang.description: Any of the site's 15 languages; default en.

sentence.description: The cable in words or its designation, as design_cable takes it.

spec.description: Instead of a sentence: a spec as design_cable takes it.
